author: PlsExplaiinn
body:
Hello, I have been playing on the server lately and I've been experiencing block lag on Nebula. Building towers, bridges, and platforms have been a hassle for me because when I quickly place blocks the block appears later, causing me to glitch into the block, and sometimes resulting in death. Hopefully this is not an issue with my computer nor internet connect to the server. Please help and I thank you for your hard and effort to run this server. 

Sincerely, JiujitsuFT.
